body.condition: \(p\) belongs to the radius-\(L\) Hölder ball \(C^{s}([0,1]^d)\).

novel.justification: This fixed-radius global \(C^s\) restriction is an instrumental strengthened regular subclass, not a condition attributed to Takatsu and Westling (2025). It is satisfied by covariate laws with smooth spline or smooth parametric densities whose coefficients range over a compact set inside the displayed Hölder ball.
